newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy hits day's highs late on Argentine frost.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy hits day's highs late on Argentine frost.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures surged to the day's highs in late dealings with support coming from concern about talk of a weekend frost in Argentina, traders said.
Talk a key analytical firm trimmed its estimate for Argentina's crop also boosted prices, they said.
Refco Inc was a late purchaser of one million bushels of July and locals were late buyers, they said.
At 1313 CDT, soybeans were eight to 22-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with May up 22 at $8.63.
